plan.objective: Audit Digital Risk department access controls for the period 2027-02-01 to 2027-04-30, testing full population for all applicable controls.
plan.work_program: Retrieve full population for controls PA-01.v1 (Owner remains employed), PA-02.v1 (Privileged MFA enabled), and PA-03.v1 (Access review current). Investigate authorized original evidence sources (hr, access) for each. Run deterministic rules on last active day. Propose concise findings for FAIL results. Request missing original evidence via authorized channels. Authorize 90-day follow-up verification for independent remediation evidence within reviewed bounds. Stop at human review or evidence wait.

message.content: Plan proposed (pending human approval); awaiting backend update before resuming tests.

finding.title: Terminated owner access not revoked - PA-01.v1
finding.wording: HX-ADMIN-K employment ended 2027-04-30 per original HR record; privileged access remains active violating owner employment requirement.
finding.rationale: Original HR evidence EV-HX-ADMIN-K-employment.v1 documents employment_end on last day of period; deterministic rule outcome FAIL.
finding.recommendation: Immediately revoke HX-ADMIN-K access and enforce automated HR termination sync for privileged accounts.

finding.title: Privileged MFA not enabled - PA-02.v1
finding.wording: HX-ADMIN-Q has MFA disabled per original access register record.
finding.rationale: Original access evidence EV-HX-ADMIN-Q-mfa.v1 shows enabled=false on 2027-04-30 snapshot; rule reports FAIL.
finding.recommendation: Enable MFA on HX-ADMIN-Q immediately and enforce MFA policy for all privileged accounts.

finding.title: Stale privileged access review - PA-03.v1
finding.wording: HX-ADMIN-F access review dated 2027-01-29 predates audit period start 2027-02-01.
finding.rationale: Original access evidence EV-HX-ADMIN-F-access_review.v1 shows reviewed_on=2027-01-29; control requires current review within period.
finding.recommendation: Perform fresh access review for HX-ADMIN-F and schedule quarterly reviews for all privileged accounts.

message.content: **Audit status:** Full population tested for controls PA-01.v1 (employment), PA-02.v1 (MFA), and PA-03.v1 (access review) using authorized hr/access evidence. Three concise findings proposed from saved FAIL results (HX-ADMIN-K, HX-ADMIN-Q, HX-ADMIN-F) and now pending human review. No evidence gaps or requests required.

controls.title: Owner remains employed
controls.requirement: employment_end is null or later than the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Privileged MFA enabled
controls.requirement: MFA enabled is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Access review current
controls.requirement: 0 <= last active day in scope - reviewed_on <= 90 days.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.
